info.name: CRM Notes
info.summary: CRM-style notes attached to address book contacts
info.description:
Create and manage CRM-style notes for your contacts. Supports multiple note types (Call, Meeting, Email, Task, General) with customizable categories. Notes are linked to address book entries and provide a timeline view of interactions.
Recommended companion app: **Contacts**. The standalone CRM Notes view works on its own, but installing the Contacts app additionally enables the in-app Notes tab and the contacts hover-menu entry, which surface a contact's notes directly inside Contacts. These integrations activate automatically when Contacts is present and stay dormant when it is not.
info.author: CRM Notes Contributors
